annotations.coverageReview: Fresh six-view survey, native front/side and initial/expanded overlays actually inspected. One Kraken head with eyes under the tied brow band and central facial tentacle roots; separate outer tentacles reviewed in body views. Brow, central upper/lower face and visible side cheek covered; battle patches expanded and visually rechecked, minimum 22 vertices. No animation approval.

review.name: Abyss Kraken
findings: Fresh source complete-face/body inspection confirms central facial tentacle roots flattening into the eyes during recoil and lower-face stretching during defeat. All 216 actual equipped-technique frames inspected front/side. Legs and outer tentacles remain connected; preserve their authored motion. Extend the binding through the complete central lower face with a continuous fade into the lower tentacles and side cheek. Sculpt, rig, textures and all original animation curves preserved; candidate only until independent and repeat visual checks pass.

Kraken supported-actions v2 candidate: all 12 enlarged raw face/body slices and all 216 actual equipped-technique frames actually inspected and pass. Upper-body rotations coordinated with the rigid face to avoid lower-tentacle folds; visible original root/leg movement retained. Replays exactly from pinned face fixture. Source promoted locally and battle/atlas regenerated; final second-pass captures started but zero final images reviewed so far. No final receipt or live approval.

Final second pass actually inspected: all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, 32 production transition slices at low/medium, 216 native equipped-technique frames in 12 lossless strips, 24 advancing companion idle frames and 16 atlas cells. All pass. Complete central-face binding and 95 upper-body rotation excursions across thirteen clips repaired together. Root, pelvis, leg and tail tracks, all translations/scales, sculpt, UVs, texture and rig preserved exactly. Independently selected visible feet retain original world paths at 97 times per clip. Seven regression tests and production build pass. Local review only; whole-roster/main/live release pending.
